title: poker: showdown resolution and pot distribution
description: No showdown logic exists. At showdown: (1) reveal all active players' hole cards, (2) call hand ranking evaluator for each player's best 7-card hand, (3) award pot to winner (or split on tie), (4) handle side pots when a player went all-in. The end_condition 'best_hand(hand + community) at showdown' is a free-form string not evaluated by check_end_conditions. Depends on: hand ranking evaluator (baize-po7) and side pot logic. Tests: test_showdown_winner_gets_pot, test_side_pot_created_on_all_in in tests/test_poker.py.
